creative_direction.name: Risograph Stride Halftone
creative_direction.brief: A flat print-shop poster: matte sea-glass risograph paper carries an oversized halftone dot field that thickens toward the lower right like a stride freezing into motion, crossed by one hard vermilion diagonal bar echoing the stiletto arch. The opaque red cutout stands centred in the lower two-thirds, its baked speculars untouched by the flat ink world, while the whole typographic monument stacks in a calm upper band: wide-tracked brand line, heavy Bodoni name, closed by a short ink rule like a press registration mark. No floor, no horizon - pure dot-gradient narrative against lacquer gloss.
creative_direction.material: risograph-printed matte paper with halftone dot gradient and hard-edge printed stripe
creative_direction.lighting: perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, flat graphic ink light with no falloff
